label: Error: order ids repeated or already published
code:
{"name": "unique-order-id", "severity": "error", "sql": """
    SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM staging_orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1))
         + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staging_orders s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_id = s.order_id))"""},

label: Warning: far fewer rows than a normal recent day
code:
{"name": "volume", "severity": "warn", "sql": """
    WITH daily AS (
        SELECT date(placed_at, '+7 hours') AS day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders
        WHERE date(placed_at, '+7 hours') BETWEEN date(:batch_day, '-7 days') AND date(:batch_day, '-1 day')
        GROUP BY day
    ), ranked AS (
        SELECT n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n) AS i, COUNT(*) OVER () AS c FROM daily
    )
    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staging_orders)
                     < 0.7 * (SELECT AVG(n) FROM ranked WHERE i IN ((c + 1) / 2, (c + 2) / 2))
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END"""},
